Name: Improved Riverland Farm. CP version now available
Author: Laurezard
Description:
[u][size=3][b]Changelog[/b][/size][/u][b]:[/b]
[u][i]v.1.11
[/i][/u][i][b]There is now a Content Patcher version available, created by user [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57731481]Blyndshot[/url][b][size=4]. [/size][quote][size=1]Thank you, mysterious stranger![/size] [/quote][/b][size=2]Please see the "Optional files" to download the CP version. The non-CP version is still the default download.[/size][/i]

[b][i][u]v1.1 - New or existing save support![/u][/i]
[i]There are now two files in the .zip.[/i][/b][i] One will spawn [/i][b]debris[/b][i] (branches, stumps, trees, weeds, and stones). Please use this version if you are starting a new game. The second file is [/i][b]blank[/b][i], meaning it only includes the changes made to the map, and will not spawn any debris. This way you can use the new Riverland map on an existing save.
[/i][i][size=1][u]v1.11 - fixed 4 tiles that were impassable.[/u] That's it. Both versions updated.[/size][/i]

[b][size=6][u]Install[/u][/size][size=6]:[/size][/b]
Drag and drop the desired version of Farm_Fishing.xnb to your Stardew>Content>Maps folder. Easy-peasy. 


[b][size=4][u]Dope Features[/u]:
[/size][/b][list]
[*][i]Multiplayer support (cabins will spawn) [/i]
[*][i]Vanilla-esque[/i]
[*][i][s]3 islands[/s] Useful large farming island[/i]
[*][i]More decorations to stave off depression[/i]
[*][i]An extra bridge to gap the void between success and crippling self-doubt[/i]
[*][i]A slightly longer pier for aesthetic vibes[/i]
[*][i]Flowers for grandpa[/i]
[*][i]More dead logs for fish to hide in[/i]
[*][i]More debris for materials and an extra burst of "victorious feeling" when finally cleared[/i]
[*][i]More pretty grass at the start (extra mixed seeds)[/i]
[*][i]Less heartbreak[/i]
[*][i]More karma[/i]
[*][i][b]2 versions for ultimate happiness: WITH/WITHOUT DEBRIS FOR NEW OR EXISTING SAVES[/b][/i]
[/list][i]

[/i][b][size=4][u]Mission Statement[/u]:[/size][/b][size=5][i]eNjoY yoUr NeW fArM liFE WiThouT tHe HasSLe oF liViNG oN an ArChiPeLAgo CoNNectEd bY Useless bRidGes ![/i]


[/size]..
I'm planning to update this when I have some ideas. Open to suggestions! Hope you enjoy ^^

Downloads.Description:
The archive contains two folders.

>"Improved Riverland Farm" will spawn debris. This is the file you should use with new games.
>"Improved Riverland Farm BLANK" contains the same map, with no debris. For use with existing saves.

Cabins work w/ both.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
